name: odq-cinnamon
limitations: Public Mint 22-series amd64 simplestreams products had no VM disk items on 2026-10-05; Ubuntu 24.04 Cinnamon fallback used.
Base image fingerprint is pinned; Ubuntu apt packages remain repository-resolved, with installed versions recorded in packages.tsv.
Daily upstream images expire. Preserve verified image artifacts in the Incus cache; never silently substitute a moving alias.
Mesa llvmpipe and virtual X11 display prove guest paths only, not physical GPU, host input, host audio or actual monitor layout.
Boot, autologin, Orca event loop and screenshot remain unqualified until real guest smoke runs. Storage pool unavailable during recipe development.
